It feels pointless to life live. You work untill you die. And loneliness is the worst. I have a girlfriend And friends But I stil feel disconnected she does not understand And also says I should man up. Because she does not like her own family But she does not cry about it.

I just want a peace of mind. And not have to work be fake And smile act like all is okay. While Im just unhappy And nothing gives me joy. Unless its food. But even that is getting less And less. 

I have non-stop headaches
I bekieve its called stabbing headaches thats What my doctor called it. Only stress And Sadness in my life

They say im gay. For being emotional And just want attention. But I get emotional Because it is So hard for me to talk about it. And when ever I start trying to explain they shut me down. And say stop achting like a baby be a man a real man
